ios.desc:
KnifeGeek is the perfect companion to any pocket knife or EDC enthusiast. KnifeGeek is a 100% free app geared to help you find the right knife at the best knives.

- Search and filter through 70K+ knives
- Add knives to your wishlist and monitor their prices over time
- Save knives to your collection and track the value of your collection
- Browse and discover knives every day
- Account syncs in realtime across web and mobile.

Join tens of thousands of pocket knife enthusiasts already making use of our web platform on mobile!


Terms & Conditions

By downloading or using the app, the terms listed at https://www.knifegeek.io/terms/ automatically apply and these terms must be agreed to when logging in. 

Privacy Policy

While KnifeGeek collects basic information such as name and email to ensure a customized experience, we never release your data to third party services that are not critical to core usage. Please review our active privacy policy here https://www.knifegeek.io/privacy
